title: Single-candidate forcing composition for MODFLOW6 plus Ribasim
central_question: Can the admitted FMR physics execute one transaction candidate from one accepted SWAP origin with both a prescribed MODFLOW bottom head and one Ribasim-owned EXTENDED_SIGNED surface-water head, without duplicate state or split candidate authority?
source_findings: The current groundwater participant materializes a prescribed bottom head only for bottom_mode=5.
The current F-APP09 surface-water participant is bounded to bottom_mode=7.
Both participants create full independent kernel candidates, so their candidates cannot be merged after execution.
fmr_b110_physical_forcing_t can carry both bottom_head and drainage_response_controls.
The groundwater head materializer copies a typed base forcing and changes only bottom_head.
The drainage-response physics itself is independent of the surface-water participant's bottom_mode=7 admission guard.
frozen_composition: Start from one accepted fmr_b110_physical_state_t origin.
Activate exactly one FMR_DRAIN_VARIANT_EXTENDED_SIGNED drainage-response level.
Materialize one finite Ribasim surface-water head into drainage_response_controls.
Use that materialized forcing as the base forcing for fmr_groundwater_head_forcing_materializer_t.
Materialize one finite MODFLOW interface head into bottom_head.
Run exactly one backend trial from the captured origin.
required_evidence: combined forcing retains Ribasim resolved surface-water head after MODFLOW-head materialization
combined forcing contains the mapped MODFLOW bottom head
single candidate is complete and mass-complete
candidate interval is exactly the frozen window
discard returns to the same accepted origin
comparison_cases: R1 positive soil-to-surface-water exchange with finite groundwater bottom head
R2 negative surface-water-to-soil exchange with finite groundwater bottom head
failure_rule: A profile rejection, missing exchange, incomplete mass, or inability to carry both forcings in one accepted trial is a genuine composition blocker. Do not work around it by running separate SWAP candidates and merging results.
pass_meaning: Kernel-level evidence that a single joint SWAP candidate is feasible with existing admitted physics. It does not yet admit a three-model orchestration or production participant.
